description: Print user and group information for each specified USER, or (when USER omitted) for the current process.

option.name: --context
tip: print only the security context of the process

option.name: --group
tip: print only the effective group ID

option.name: --name
tip: print a name instead of a number, for -u,-g,-G

option.name: --real
tip: print the real ID instead of the effective ID, with -u,-g,-G

option.name: --user
tip: print only the effective user ID

option.name: --zero
tip: delimit entries with NUL characters, not whitespace; not permitted in default format

option.name: -a
tip: ignore, for compatibility with other versions
